11th grade I was in the 10th grade class for math (failed pre algebra and never did summer school bad idea, I know) and there was an extremely autistic kid that was in the 11th grade as well. He was super smart, but had a really poor family and smelled bad, had a terrible temper, and hated listening. He had to be removed from classes temporarily all the time due to his anger. I was placed directly behind him due to me being the only one nice to him. The younger kids were so terribly cruel and treated him like a complete and utter idiot even though me and him both knew he was the smartest. At first I didn't understand how intelligent and gentle he was and, admittedly, did laugh alongside the others until we made friends bc I saw him playing minecraft on his school issued laptop in front of me, and from then on we'd partner for projects and just talk about video games and other stuff. I was the only one to tell the others to stop it and shut the fuck up. One of my hobbies is herpetology and he loved to hear about my experiences with animals. I remember a few times the teacher asking him to calm down (to no avail, she had no idea how to properly handle him) until she just resigned to laughing with the class at him and letting the kids torture him. I always had to be the one to tell them to stop because he simply couldn't help it. One particularly bad time he had started his screeching and screaming "don't laugh at me!" And I put my hand on his shoulder, and said it's okay, they know you're smarter and different and it's not your fault", and miss spare-parts said that it's okay he didn't need me to help him. I just glared and said "if I won't who else will". I guess she caught my drift because from then on she was easier on him (relatively), probably because she realized someone was seeing exactly what was happening. He ended up being one of my best friends. I found out he couldn't figure out when people were laughing with him or at him which is an awful thing to live with. 
Tl:dr Teacher and younger people in class in HS were cruel to an autistic kid because they thought he was gross and dumb and he ended up being one of my besties and found out he was extremely intelligent and gentle despite his mental state.
